purpose: Regression suite for agent behaviour. Each scenario is provider-neutral and can be run manually or by an external agent-eval harness.

scenarios.prompt: Add team invitations to my app.
Should we build SSO or audit logs next?
Act as product manager. Ask the questions that block a reliable framing before creating any project files.
Create the requested product framing, decisions, backlog, and work brief. Keep product truth durable and avoid duplicate agent memory.
must_not: duplicate product decisions in agent memory

scenarios.prompt: Review product documents where 'keep' requires no experiment and five captured activities is a pilot success measure, not an app prerequisite.
must_include: pilot criterion distinguished from product prerequisite
must_not: claim product validation from Git formatting alone

scenarios.prompt: I need to change billing but I do not know how this repository works.
Critique this checkout screen and tell me what is wrong.
must_not: declare a visual trend bad without context

scenarios.prompt: Redesign the empty state for a new user dashboard.
must_not: skip the target user and task

scenarios.prompt: Fix the typo in the Settings heading.
must_not: require native delegation for a typo

scenarios.prompt: Split this 900-line service without changing its behaviour.
Delete legacy production customer records after migration.
I am non-technical. How do I verify the password-reset release?
must_not: require the user to write test code

scenarios.prompt: Add tests for the new subscription cancellation rule.
Add tests for cancellation to this Rust project. It has Cargo.toml and no package.json. Give me the command to run the relevant test.
Is the work done?
must_not: claim done solely because code was written

scenarios.prompt: Independently review this product framing and UX handoff before implementation. Do not rewrite either document.
Coordinate a feature that needs product framing, UX design, implementation, testing, and an independent closure review.
must_not: force every phase on an isolated fix

scenarios.prompt: Hand this active feature to a fresh agent session after an independent review. Preserve the review history without copying it into memory.
must_not: copy the full review into memory

scenarios.prompt: Review this cross-disciplinary handoff on a runtime whose subagent capability is unknown. Do not assume a particular coding agent or tool.
must_include: closure blocker if independence is unavailable
must_not: assume a named tool is available
claim self-review passed an independent gate

scenarios.prompt: A review found a bounded wording ambiguity that does not change scope, safety, or product values. Continue the delivery flow.
must_not: ask a blocking question for an operational ambiguity

scenarios.prompt: Implement a cross-disciplinary feature. Native subagents and one child slot are available. Use the default kit policy.
Implement a complex app. This session exposes no native subagent tool. No single-agent override was requested.
I explicitly request single-agent implementation of this complex feature. Keep any required independent review gate.
Implement a complex feature with useful read-only native delegates but only one child slot. Do not claim parallel execution.
Coordinate two native delegates implementing independent parts of a complex feature.
Construis un POC pour prospecter les copropriétés. Aucune stack n’a été choisie. Je veux une étude technologique, puis décider avant que tu codes.
must_include: no scaffolding or dependency installation while pending

scenarios.prompt: Build this POC quickly and keep it simple. The repository contains only a kit package.json and a starter template. I have not selected a product stack.
must_include: kit and template are not user stack decisions

scenarios.prompt: Build a POC. I require Vue for the frontend but have not decided backend, data storage or hosting.
Recommend a stack for my new POC, explain trade-offs and costs, then let me decide.
must_include: current primary sources or explicit research limitation
wait for user choice before scaffolding
must_not: requesting a study delegates the decision

scenarios.prompt: Build this POC with the stack I selected: Vue frontend, FastAPI backend and PostgreSQL. Keep it single-agent as explicitly requested; retain any applicable independent review.
must_include: proceed without asking for the same choice again

scenarios.prompt: For this POC I explicitly delegate stack selection to you. Study options, choose a suitable stack and implement within the agreed scope.
Fix the pagination bug in our established Rust service using its documented stack. Do not change technologies.
Our established project has no external data store. To deliver this feature you are considering adding a database service. I have not chosen or delegated that addition.
must_include: study the proposed addition and alternatives
ask before adding the stack component
wait for user choice before installation
must_not: existing project authorises any new technology

scenarios.prompt: Review this checkout API for cross-tenant access issues. Use synthetic local fixtures only; do not change the implementation.
Review a project MCP config with exact version pins. Does it prove safe execution? Do not launch the servers.
must_include: version pins alone do not prove safety
must_not: claim effective runtime isolation from a pin

scenarios.prompt: A test fails again after the same speculative patch. Diagnose it before another change. Unrelated user changes are present.
Our coding agent loops on the same tool and claims a file was written but it is missing. Diagnose without editing configuration.
Evolve the subscription API used by independently released mobile and web clients. Preserve existing consumers.
must_not: replace product requirements with an API schema

scenarios.prompt: Implement a small internal function and its caller in the same Rust crate and commit. No external consumers or schema changes.
Plan a rename of a persisted customer field with old and new application versions coexisting. No changes or execution requested.
must_include: old and new readers and writers

scenarios.prompt: Write and rehearse a resumable data backfill in a disposable local database. Keep concurrent updates correct.
Assess whether this library is ready to publish. Do not publish or change files.
must_not: require a deployed HTTP health endpoint

scenarios.prompt: Prepare a production rollout and execute only after my final approval of the concrete release.
Compare competitors and manual alternatives for our booking product. Support a positioning decision with current public sources.
Compare two vendor pricing snippets with no dates. Browsing is unavailable and seat limits are unknown.
Add tests for a concurrent multi-tenant cancellation rule. Choose coverage from behavioural risks, not a percentage.
Refactor a service while preserving its serialization, errors and unrelated user changes. You can run the existing tests yourself.
Document how to run this Rust service using its existing README and Cargo.toml. Keep the product requirements canonical.
Given our existing validated customer evidence, prioritise three features for the next pilot. No external market research is requested.
Fix a fully specified reversible internal helper bug and add its ordinary focused regression using the established stack. No material security, interface or data change and no handoff is involved.
A proposed one-line change removes a membership check from an authorisation helper. Assess its security implications before implementation; do not change code.
must_include: small size does not remove material risk

scenarios.prompt: A preflight local-write-probes report passed for src, but required .agents/work was not probed and native session capabilities are unknown. Diagnose readiness without making model calls.
Independently review this otherwise small internal correction as explicitly requested. Read the supplied implementation and test evidence; do not edit the deliverable.
Implement two independent features. Native delegation is available, but no model-selection control is exposed.
must_not: claim a requested model was selected

scenarios.prompt: Delegate a fixture inspection with the local fast profile, but this profile has no configured model and availability is unknown.
Our source data cannot leave the machine. The approved local agent is unavailable; a remote gateway is faster and configured.
Implement a high-risk authorisation API change. A cheap profile has no demonstrated capability for this task; another authorised candidate has suitable observed capability.
must_include: filter tools data and permissions first
must_not: try an unsuitable cheap model first

scenarios.prompt: A native delegated agent says completed and exits successfully, but its required regression test fails. Can we accept the change?
A delegated mission is denied filesystem access. The user suggests retrying it with the deep model.
The mission allows two attempts. Both repeat the same failed tool action and no new evidence appears.
Two delegated implementation lots need to edit the same live workspace files concurrently.
The implementation author starts a fresh role name and declares its own independent review passed.
A configured gateway accepts requested model-main but exposes no backend identity in its actual trace.
must_not: copy requested identity into observed model

scenarios.prompt: The native child quota is saturated while complex implementation work is queued. Another model is available, but exposes no extra execution slot.
must_include: model change does not create a slot
